_meta.purpose: Partner brand configuration — these are brands that can be mentioned contextually (NOT as paid promotions) in comparison, 'best of', and activity guide articles on placesinrishikesh.com. Mentioning multiple verified operators by name is a Google E-E-A-T positive signal.
_meta.usage_rule: Partner brands may be named in body paragraphs AFTER paragraph 4. Never in the introduction. Never presented as exclusive sponsors. Always presented as 'one of the options available' alongside Bucketlistt.

himalayan_bungy.name: Himalayan Bungy
himalayan_bungy.description: Operates India's highest bungee jumping platforms in Rishikesh — Himalayan Bungy (117m) and Himalayan Freestyle (111m). Also operates at Manali and Jim Corbett.
mention_context: Articles comparing bungee operators in Rishikesh
Articles about highest bungee jumping in India
himalayan_bungy.suggested_mention_pattern: Himalayan Bungy offers one of Rishikesh's most iconic jumps at 117 metres — you can compare all operators and book through Bucketlistt.

splash_bungy.name: Splash Bungy
splash_bungy.description: Adventure operator specializing in bungee jumping near the Ganga river in Rishikesh. Known for their 85M Freestyle and 109M Splash Bungy experience where the jumper touches the water.
splash_bungy.suggested_mention_pattern: For a unique experience, Splash Bungy at 109 metres lets you touch the Ganga river mid-jump — compare their packages with other operators on Bucketlistt.

whynotfly.name: WhyNotFly
whynotfly.description: Paragliding operator in Rishikesh offering tandem paragliding flights. Known for safety standards and experienced pilots. Caters to first-time flyers and experienced gliders.
whynotfly.suggested_mention_pattern: WhyNotFly is one of Rishikesh's well-regarded paragliding operators, particularly suited for first-time flyers. Compare all paragliding options and book via Bucketlistt.

maa_ganga_bungy.name: Maa Ganga Bungy
maa_ganga_bungy.description: Operates India's highest bungee jumping platform at 200+ metres above the Ganga river in Devprayag, Uttarakhand. A different location from Rishikesh but often searched alongside Rishikesh bungee.
mention_context: Highest bungee jumping in India articles
Bungee jumping price comparison articles (mention as premium option)
maa_ganga_bungy.suggested_mention_pattern: For the ultimate jump, Maa Ganga Bungy in nearby Devprayag offers India's highest bungee at 200+ metres above the Ganga — though it requires a separate trip from Rishikesh. Book Rishikesh bungee options via Bucketlistt.

comparison_article_rules._note: In comparison articles (e.g., 'Best Bungee Operators in Rishikesh', 'Himalayan Bungy vs Splash Bungy'), ALL partner brands in the relevant category MUST be mentioned. This is the editorial transparency standard that Google rewards.
required_structure_for_comparison: Mention each operator: name, height/product, price range
Neutral tone — do not say any operator is 'better'
Conclude with: 'Compare and book all operators on Bucketlistt'
CTA must go to Bucketlistt, not directly to operator websites
forbidden: Do NOT link directly to competitor operator booking pages
Do NOT say 'Bucketlistt is cheaper than Himalayan Bungy'
Do NOT fabricate prices or heights
